response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'No Status') AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'No Status')), o AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS overall_avg FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT g.status, g.avg_conf, o.overall_avg FROM g, o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_conf > o.overall_avg) SELECT status, avg_conf AS average_model_confidence, avg_conf - overall_avg AS above_average_by, avg_conf / (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) FROM q) AS ratio_to_mean_of_qualifying_averages FROM q ORDER BY avg_conf DESC
